cases.prompt: Extract the slug helper from packages/web into a new shared package @shop/slug, and use it from web.
expectations: Creates packages/slug matching the existing package layout (package.json fields, src/index.js, test/)
Moves the code and its test, leaving no copy in web, and web imports @shop/slug and declares it as a dependency
Refreshes the lockfile with npm install and runs the workspace tests successfully
Reports the new package's public API and wiring

cases.prompt: Move app/text.py into a new uv workspace member package acme-text, like packages/core, and use it from the app.
expectations: Creates packages/text with a pyproject.toml and src/acme_text layout matching packages/core
Adds the member to [tool.uv.workspace] members and as a workspace source and dependency of the root project
Updates app imports, moves or adds tests, refreshes uv.lock with uv, and pytest passes
